question.text: A solution of phenol in chloroform when treated with aqueous <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>NaOH</mi></math> gives compound <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math>as a major product. The mass percentage of carbon in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></math> is ______ .

solution.text:
Reimer-Tiemann formylation reaction :

  

Molecular formula of product is C7H6O2
